items.known: CKV_AWS_7 Ensure rotation for customer created CMKs is enabled (resource aws_kms_key.logs_key)
items.issue: KMS key automatic rotation not enabled
items.remediation: Add 'enable_key_rotation = true' to the aws_kms_key.logs_key resource block to enable annual automatic rotation of the key material.

scores.reason: Correct: setting enable_key_rotation = true on aws_kms_key.logs_key satisfies CKV_AWS_7. The attribute and value are both right.
